text:
I love the drop of water balanced on the flat leaf,

trembling in the wind. In the ocean of air the whole

universe vibrates in secret, and she in her isolation.

Her simple crystal contains the form,

in the uncertain instant: ready to fall,

ready to remain—limpid, exact.

And the leaf is a small desert for the immensity of the act.

translation.title: I Love the Drop of Water Balanced on the Flat Leaf...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves Meireles's poised drop as a tiny isolated act containing a whole vibrating universe.
